title: Neural solutions of coupled ghost and gluon Dyson--Schwinger equations in Landau gauge
summary: The coupled ghost and gluon Dyson--Schwinger equations (DSEs) of four-dimensional Landau-gauge Yang--Mills (YM) theory are solved with a neural representation trained only from renormalized equation residuals. The neural and fixed-point solutions agree at the percent level and remain stable under changes of initialization, network size, integration grid, and infrared boundary condition. Variations of the three-gluon vertex model produce substantially larger effects than the neural error. The MiniMOM ultraviolet running and the sign change of the gluon Schwinger function are also reproduced…
